title: isoutlier

gpu_support.notes: Supported floating gpuArray forms use an owning-provider host fallback and preserve explicit residency. GPU movmedian, SamplePoints, and DataVariables restrictions are enforced before gather.

description: `isoutlier` returns a logical mask for numeric observations outside method-specific lower and upper thresholds. RunMat supports numeric array inputs, default dimension reduction, and the `"median"`, `"mean"`, `"quartiles"`, `"percentiles"`, `"movmedian"`, and `"movmean"` detection methods.
notes: The default method is `"median"`, using three scaled median absolute deviations from the median.
`"percentiles"` accepts a two-element percentile vector and does not use `ThresholdFactor`.
`ThresholdFactor` is supported for median, mean, quartiles, movmedian, and movmean methods.
Typed-integer data, dimensions, moving windows, and threshold controls are independently declared RunMat extensions. Values entering floating detection must be exactly representable as double.
Table, timetable, `SamplePoints`, `DataVariables`, and `OutlierLocations` forms are reported as unsupported for `isoutlier` in this numeric-array implementation.
Automatic internal residency may gather transparently; documented explicit floating gpuArray forms preserve logical and threshold output residency.
